name: Malta
summary: EU citizens only register. Non-EU citizens (US and others) can get permanent residence through the MPRP (EUR 99,000 in government payments plus a EUR 375,000 property or EUR 14,000 rent) or a Nomad permit at EUR 42,000 a year. Citizenship by investment ended in 2025. The Global Residence Programme (tax status) is replaced on 1 January 2027 by the Individual Tax Programme with much higher thresholds.
naturalisation: Not sourced from an official text (open question). Malta's ordinary naturalisation is generally reported as around 5 years of residence, but this was not verified for 2026.
dual_citizenship_note: Malta generally allows dual citizenship (general knowledge; not re-sourced).

routes.tax_note: Tax status depends on residence and domicile; EU citizens can also apply for the Global Residence Programme.
routes.name: EU free movement (registration)
routes.summary: EU citizens may live in Malta and register as EU residents after 3 months; permanent residence after 5 years.
routes.requirements: Valid ID or passport; worker, self-employed or economically inactive with resources and health cover. Permanent right after 5 years of continuous legal residence (Directive 2004/38).

routes.investment_options: Lease alternative: EUR 14,000 a year rent instead of buying.
routes.fees_note: EUR 37,000 contribution + EUR 60,000 administration + EUR 2,000 donation, excluding property; EUR 7,500 per extra adult dependant. Property is held for the programme period (reported as at least 5 years).
routes.family: Spouse and dependent minors included; extra adult dependants EUR 7,500 each.
routes.tax_note: A permit does not make you tax resident. Combine with the Global Residence Programme for the 15% remittance rate.
routes.name: Malta Permanent Residence Programme (MPRP)
routes.summary: Permanent residence for non-EU nationals: EUR 99,000 of government payments plus a EUR 375,000 property or EUR 14,000 a year rent, and proof of capital.
routes.requirements: Government contribution EUR 37,000; administration fee EUR 60,000 (EUR 15,000 on submission, EUR 45,000 at approval in principle); donation EUR 2,000. Residential property bought for at least EUR 375,000 or leased for at least EUR 14,000 a year (registered with the Housing Authority), secured within 8 months of approval. Capital: EUR 500,000 with EUR 150,000 liquid, or EUR 650,000 with EUR 75,000 liquid. Legal Notice 146 of 2025 (applications from 1 January 2025; another firm says 22 July 2025).

routes.investment_options: Rent from EUR 9,600 a year instead.
routes.tax_note: This is a tax status as well as a residence right: 15% on remitted foreign income, EUR 15,000 minimum annual tax. Sources differ on the 2027 minimum tax (EUR 35,000 per several firms).
routes.name: Global Residence Programme (to 31 December 2026), then Individual Tax Programme
routes.summary: A special tax status (15% on foreign income remitted to Malta, EUR 15,000 minimum tax) tied to a Maltese home; replaced for new applicants from 1 January 2027.
routes.requirements: Buy a property for at least EUR 275,000 (EUR 220,000 in Gozo or the south) or rent for at least EUR 9,600 a year (EUR 8,750 in Gozo or the south); minimum tax EUR 15,000 a year; health insurance. From 1 January 2027 (Legal Notice 195 of 2026) the Individual Tax Programme replaces four programmes: property from EUR 700,000, rent about EUR 14,000 a year (one source), minimum tax EUR 35,000 per several firms, 5-year status. Applications filed by 31 December 2026 stay on current terms until 31 December 2031.

routes.fees_note: About EUR 300 per person plus residence card fee, per one guide; unconfirmed.
routes.tax_note: Guides report 0% tax in the first 12 months on qualifying remote income then 10%; not confirmed from an official source.
routes.name: Nomad Residence Permit
routes.summary: For remote workers with active income of EUR 42,000 a year (about EUR 3,500 a month) from outside Malta.
routes.requirements: Gross income of at least EUR 42,000 a year from a foreign employer or clients (passive income does not count). Valid 1 year, renewable up to 3 times (4 years in total); renewal needs about 5 months' presence in Malta over the preceding 12. Non-EU/EEA/Swiss only. Sources from before 1 April 2024 quote EUR 32,400.
routes.physical_presence: About 5 months in Malta in the previous 12 to renew

routes.status_note: Court of Justice ruled on 29 April 2025 (Commission v Malta, C-181/23) that the scheme breaches EU law; Act XXI of 2025 (gazetted 24 July 2025) ended the framework. A discretionary 'citizenship by merit' route with no price replaced it.
routes.name: Citizenship by Naturalisation for Exceptional Services by Direct Investment (MEIN)
routes.summary: The programme that gave a Maltese passport for a EUR 600,000 to 750,000 contribution plus property is closed.
routes.requirements: Closed. Former terms: government contribution EUR 600,000 (36-month track) or EUR 750,000 (12-month track), property of EUR 700,000 to buy or EUR 16,000 a year to rent (held 5 years), donation of EUR 10,000. Existing certificate holders' position is unsettled.
